title: Indoor waterpark, bubble-pool deck and exercise floor
description: Three branch photographs were inspected: the indoor waterpark with pool-edge rails and a slide stair tower, lap lanes beneath the bubble cover with deck seating, and an exercise-equipment aisle. They help orient visitors but do not establish a continuous route, ramp slope, lift availability or operation, transfer support, toilets or changing facilities. Capture dates and current layouts are unknown. Images remain on the YMCA website; no reuse licence was found.

title: Indoor pool edges, decks and splash features
description: Eight images were inspected; four useful orientation views show the lap-pool edges and decks from different angles and the warm-water play area with rails, bench seating and overhead water jets. Other images are swimming or slide close-ups, including outdoor attractions, and should not be mistaken for indoor access views. Some photographs contain visitors. Capture dates, current configurations, lift provision, transfer assistance, locker-room routes, thresholds and toilets remain unknown. Images stay with Silverlake; no reuse licence was found.

title: Pool deck, connecting doors and gym panoramas
description: Two original panoramas embedded on Bayley’s virtual-tour page were inspected through all six image faces each. The pool view shows tiled deck surfaces, pool-edge rails/ladders, glass doors to the adjoining exercise area and chairs beyond the glass. The gym view shows equipment aisles, a lever-handled door, benches and a drinking fountain. Panorama metadata says September 13, 2022; capture dates and current conditions are unconfirmed. The images do not establish lift availability, transfer help, doorway clearances, a continuous entrance route, track access or toilet/changing arrangements. Only the pool and fitness-center scenes were reviewed. Original panoramic stitching and a black floor patch remain as published. No reuse licence was found; imagery stays with its publisher.
publisher: Bayley · panoramas hosted by Mount St. Joseph University
documentDate: Panorama metadata September 13, 2022; capture dates unconfirmed

title: Access vehicle boarding ramp in 2024
description: One operator photograph in the April 10, 2024 announcement shows an Access vehicle with open doors and a deployed ramp, yellow edge markings, a wheelchair user on the ramp and a staff member inside. The lower end of the ramp is outside the frame. This is historical orientation for that vehicle, not evidence of the current fleet, the vehicle assigned to a trip, ramp slope or capacity, securement procedures, or MetroNow! equipment. Capture date is unconfirmed. The image remains with Metro; no reuse licence was found.
documentDate: April 10, 2024 publication; photo capture date unconfirmed
